label: Steel-walled experimental room (6DRIR-DL)
note: readme.md: nearly cuboid (a pillar on one side wall), walls, floor and ceiling of 2 mm steel plate; volume from the approximate dimensions; conditions: no-obstacles, and wedges (absorptive panels on the walls and absorptive wedges in the four corners); the IRs are truncated by the authors at 1/3 s; the readme calls it the experimental room and does not say where it is; the 1/3 s truncation leaves no decay times below 500 Hz, while the room's long reverberation is at low frequencies (octave T20 of the raw files about 1.1-1.6 s at 125 Hz and 0.6 s at 250 Hz without absorbers); RIRDB's mid-frequency decay time (0.37 s without and 0.24 s with absorbers, mostly from T20 without them) does not show it, and the C grades follow from the truncation, not from an analysis error
